_comment: Applied to every transaction on both /webhook and /backfill, after Starling's own spendingCategory but before it's resolved to an Actual category — a rule's "category" wins over spendingCategory when both apply. POST /rules/reload picks up edits without a restart.

rules.name: Round up
rules._comment: Illustrative default — check what your own round-up transfers actually look like (userNote/reference/counterPartyName) and adjust the match below; this hasn't been verified against a real round-up transaction.

rules.name: Chip
rules._comment: Chip uses several legal-entity names for different products (Chip Financial Ltd, Chip Financial Investments Ltd, bare 'Chip') — merge them under one payee. Deliberately excludes the Seccl Custody-routed investment transactions (identified only by a CHIP1- reference, not the counterparty name) since that's a different counterparty text.
